presentation.label: AMP + CAB
presentation.summary: An amp and speaker cabinet for any track: drive, a three-band tone stack and four cabinets.
presentation.overview: Like a guitar amp it is mono: both sides are summed, run through a 90 Hz high-pass and a 7 kHz band-limit, then at twice the sample rate into GAIN and a soft curve that flattens at full scale, with the level following GAIN so it adds drive, not volume. A tone stack splits the sound at 300 Hz and 2.2 kHz (BASS, MID and TREB set each band, flat at the centre), then one of four speaker cabinets or none, a DC blocker and LEV, to both outputs. Use it to dirty up a drum bus, give a synth line an amp's grit, or put a sample through a small speaker.
highlights: GAIN from clean to fully driven at about the same volume, with a curve that rounds off instead of hard clipping
BASS, MID and TREB each cut to silence or boost up to +6 dB, and are exactly flat at the centre
Four cabinets (1X10, 1X12, 2X12, 4X12) or OFF, each its own low thump, upper-mid bump and roll-off
usage: Pick COMBO in a track's FX1 or FX2 list, start with GAIN around 40, then turn CAB to taste.

controls.name: GAIN
controls.doc: Drive into the amp: +0 dB at 0, +22 dB at 40, +38 dB at 127

controls.name: BASS
controls.doc: Lows below 300 Hz: cut to silence at -64, flat at 0, +6 dB at +63

controls.name: MID
controls.doc: Mids, 300 Hz to 2.2 kHz: cut to silence at -64, flat at 0, +6 dB at +63

controls.name: TREB
controls.doc: Highs above 2.2 kHz: cut to silence at -64, flat at 0, +6 dB at +63

controls.name: CAB
controls.doc: Speaker cabinet: OFF, one 10-inch, one 12-inch, two 12-inch or four 12-inch

controls.name: LEV
controls.doc: Output level (LEV/64)^2: silence at 0, 0 dB at 64, +12 dB at 127

limitations: Experimental draft: rendered bit for bit against its model in dsp_host and installed in the emulator; not yet run on a unit.
Mono, like a guitar amp: stereo input comes out in mono on both sides.
No free effect id is left for card builds (docs/OCTATRACK_MORE_EFFECT_IDS.md); over USB the base assigns the live id.
CAB switches its filters at once, so turning it while audio plays can click.
At high GAIN with loud, bright input some aliasing remains, even at 2x (TESTING.md, Sound quality).

cpuPrice.conditions: fresh project, bank A pattern 01 Part 1, no samples or trigs, transport started by the tool; base 5d2fe44d; 3 readings of 8 s a state. Frame interrupt 23.7 % before, 23.7 % installed and used nowhere, 23.7 % on T1 FX2; CPU meter 35.8 % before, 35.8 % at rest, 36.4 % in use.

tests.summary: verify.py: bit for bit against reference.py in dsp_host (noise, tones, every CAB, automation, trig splits, LFO fraction bits, dirty state, two instances), exact silence and a silent tail, 331.8 instructions a sample. Emulator: installs, draws its page, trial without fault. fx:audit: no DC, no clipping, every knob changes the sound, digital silence after input; aliasing passes at moderate levels, fails loud and bright at high drive. Hardware, stress and CPU price not yet run.

license.declaration: Original code and filter design by sebasprosala-sys under MIT. Filters from Robert Bristow-Johnson's Audio EQ Cookbook formulas, the oversampler from Valenzuela and Constantinides' published half-band design; no impulse response, curve or voicing is taken from any product. No Elektron firmware, routines or tables.

access.location: A track's FX1 or FX2 effect list.
steps: Install COMBO on a unit running the Modwerk USB base, then select an audio track.
Hold FUNC and press FX1 (or FX2), turn LEVEL to COMBO and press YES.
Press FX1 (or FX2) for COMBO's knobs: GAIN, BASS, MID, TREB, CAB and LEV.
